title: Accept link-fresh out-of-order ACK counters without replaying duplicates
description: Security codereview found FragmentSender uses a scalar ACK high-water mark even though link replay uses a sliding bitmap. A valid unseen lower counter arriving after a higher counter is rejected, allowing reordering to suppress a useful ACK. Consume atomic link-layer replay acceptance or keep equivalent session replay state: exclude frames before session creation, allow each link-accepted in-window out-of-order current-session ACK exactly once, reject duplicates. Add 102-then-101 and duplicate-101 tests.
notes: Later correctness review identified a T=0 ambiguity: accepting unseen lower ACK counters lets an older C=1 override newer state because there is no generation discriminator. Resolve by adding a real session generation discriminator or retain ordinary unsigned session high-water and reject lower counters; do not implement out-of-order acceptance in isolation.
